handoffs.message: All artifacts delivered: vectorbt_adapter.py (GovernedVectorbtInputAdapter + StubVectorbtBackend + VectorbtBackend), smoke_test.py (passes, assertions OK), test_adapter.py (26/26 pass after syntax fix). OSS_INTEGRATION_CHECKLIST.md advanced from version-pinned to smoke-tested. Please review for acceptance.

Review changes requested: GovernedVectorbtInputAdapter currently ignores per-instrument date ordering and preserves caller record order at services/research/vectorbt/adapter/vectorbt_adapter.py:127-159, so unsorted OHLCV input can silently change backtest results. Fresh repro on current snapshot: reversing AAA records changes stub total_return from 0.008743 to 0.0 while smoke/unit tests still pass. Sort or validate records chronologically per instrument and add regression coverage before returning to review.

Date-ordering fix complete. GovernedVectorbtInputAdapter now sorts per-instrument bars by ISO date field before storing (vectorbt_adapter.py:127-165). Two regression tests added to test_adapter.py: reversed-date input produces identical ohlcv_by_instrument bars, and identical per-instrument backtest metrics. 28/28 unit tests pass, smoke test OK. Ready for re-review.

Review changes requested: expand the reversed-date regression to assert the full AAA per_instrument_metrics payload rather than only total_return, and refresh the vectorbt OSS checklist evidence from 26 to 28 passing tests so the artifact matches current verification.

Expanded reversed-date regression to assert all 5 AAA per_instrument_metrics keys (total_return, sharpe_ratio, max_drawdown, trade_count, num_bars) via subTest loop. Refreshed OSS checklist evidence from 26 to 28 passing tests. 28/28 pass, 5 subtests pass. Committed 449bcb9. Ready for re-review.
Review approved after re-running smoke test and 28 unit tests locally; the per-instrument date sort fix and expanded five-metric regression coverage satisfy the reopened acceptance checks.
